storyCards.fact:
Bonnie Tyler's "Total Eclipse Of The Heart" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 29 weeks on the chart.

Total Eclipse Of The Heart was released in 1983.
